_comment: Reviewed baseline of DELIBERATE skips in the Playwright suite (STAB-8, owner 2026-11-19). Read by tests/e2e/skip-accounting.js from stack-death-reporter.js: a skip NOT listed here fails the run, naming the test; an entry that no longer skips fails as stale (except unsupported-environment, which is host-dependent). Project-only gating is NOT listed here: tag the describe @desktop-only / @mobile-only / @a11y-desktop-only and let the project's grepInvert in playwright.config.js filter it, so it is never counted as a skip. `title` is the describe/test path joined by ' > ' (empty describes omitted), `projects` are Playwright project names. Categories: unsupported-environment | data-dependent | missing-fixture | temporary-exclusion.

entries.title: real OCR: a committed screenshot lands on the right sides
entries.reason: Needs the server's Tesseract OCR (/api/trade/import-screenshot/status enabled && available). e2e.yml installs neither tesseract nor its language data, so CI skips; a developer host with Tesseract runs it. Installing Tesseract on the runner would convert this to a real test.

entries.title: real OCR: an uncropped full-page screenshot imports exactly the trade
entries.reason: Same host capability as the sibling real-OCR test: skips when the server reports OCR unavailable.
